# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 18

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 018
**Total Disagreements:** 3

---

## Disagreement 1 — word order in v.2 conclusion

**Verse:** v.2
**LOGOS:** "where the beginning is, the end will be"
**PNEUMA:** "the end is where the beginning is"
**Issue:** Word order. The Coptic states it as a conditional: "where the beginning is, there will the end be." LOGOS follows the Coptic order.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** LOGOS word order retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "have you already discovered" vs. "have you even found"

**Verse:** v.2
**LOGOS:** "have you already discovered"
**PNEUMA:** "have you even found"
**Issue:** "Even" (PNEUMA) adds a dismissive edge not in the Coptic. "Already" (LOGOS) captures the temporal priority.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Have you already discovered" — LOGOS reading.

---

## Disagreement 3 — "will not taste death" vs. "will never die"

**Verse:** v.3
**EMET/LOGOS:** "will not taste death"
**PNEUMA:** "will never die"
**Issue:** Consistent rendering of the death-idiom across Sayings 1, 18, and 19 is important for recognizing the structural echo. "Taste death" is the recurring idiom.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Will not taste death" — consistent with Saying 1 and throughout.

---
